en.L: And David did not take their number from twenty years old and below, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said to multiply Israel like the stars of the heavens.
en.B: David did not count those who were twenty years old or younger, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had promised to make Israel as many as the stars in the sky.
en.R: David did not count the men who were twenty years old or younger. This was because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had promised to make the people of Israel as many as the stars in the sky.

es.L: Y no tomó David el número de los de veinte años abajo, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho que multiplicaría a Israel como las estrellas de los cielos.
es.B: David no contó a los que tenían veinte años o menos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había prometido hacer a Israel tan numeroso como las estrellas del cielo.
es.R: David no contó a los hombres que tenían veinte años o menos. Esto fue porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había prometido hacer al pueblo de Israel tan numeroso como las estrellas del cielo.

fr.L: Et David ne fit pas le compte de ceux qui avaient vingt ans et au-dessous, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit qu’il multiplierait Israël comme les étoiles du ciel.
fr.B: David ne fit pas recenser ceux qui avaient vingt ans ou moins, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait promis de rendre Israël aussi nombreux que les étoiles du ciel.
fr.R: David n’a pas fait compter les hommes de vingt ans ou moins. C’était parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait promis de rendre le peuple d’Israël aussi nombreux que les étoiles du ciel.

sw.L: Lakini Daudi hakuchukua hesabu yao tangu mwana wa miaka ishirini na chini, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema kuwaongeza Israeli kama nyota za mbinguni.
sw.B: Daudi hakuwahesabu wale waliokuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini au chini, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameahidi kuwafanya Israeli kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani.
sw.R: Daudi hakuwahesabu wanaume waliokuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini au chini. Hii ilikuwa kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa ameahidi kuwafanya watu wa Israeli kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani.

vi.L: Đa-vít không lấy số những người từ hai mươi tuổi trở xuống, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán sẽ làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên đông như sao trên trời.
vi.B: Đa-vít không kiểm tra những người từ hai mươi tuổi trở xuống, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên đông như sao trên trời.
vi.R: Đa-vít không đếm những người từ hai mươi tuổi trở xuống. Đó là vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa làm cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đông như sao trên trời.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗은 20세 이하인 자들의 수는 세지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 하늘의 별처럼 많게 하겠다고 말씀하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 다윗은 20세 이하인 사람들은 세지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘을 하늘의 별처럼 많게 하겠다고 약속하셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 다윗은 20세 이하인 남자들은 세지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 백성을 하늘의 별처럼 많게 하겠다고 약속하셨기 때문이다.

pt.L: E Davi não tomou o número deles de vinte anos para baixo, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito que multiplicaria Israel como as estrelas dos céus.
pt.B: Davi não contou os que tinham vinte anos ou menos, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha prometido tornar Israel tão numeroso como as estrelas do céu.
pt.R: Davi não contou os homens que tinham vinte anos ou menos. Isso porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha prometido fazer o povo de Israel tão numeroso como as estrelas do céu.

decisions.choice: to multiply Israel like the stars of the heavens: the promise to Abraham
decisions.reason: The LORD promised Abraham descendants as many as the stars (Genesis 15:5; 22:17), and repeated it to Isaac (Genesis 26:4). Moses recalls it in Exodus 32:13 and Deuteronomy 1:10. A people God had promised to make countless was not to be counted in full.

decisions.choice: from twenty and below: those too young for military service
decisions.reason: Men were counted for the army from twenty years old and up (Numbers 1:3). David's count, like Moses' census, covered only men of fighting age.

decisions.choice: had said: had promised
decisions.reason: The verb "say" here refers to what the LORD had declared he would do, a promise.

decisions.choice: the men
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that "those" counted were the men, as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: as estrelas dos céus (L); as estrelas do céu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The promise to Abraham (m1) is heard in the words of Genesis 15:5 in Portuguese, "Olha para os céus" (L) and "Olha para o céu" (B, R), with the plural at Literal for the Hebrew plural.

source.text: יוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֜ה הֵחֵ֤ל לִמְנוֹת֙ וְלֹ֣א כִלָּ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י בָזֹ֛את קֶ֖צֶף עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א עָלָה֙ הַמִּסְפָּ֔ר בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר דִּבְרֵֽי־הַיָּמִ֖ים לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count, and not he finished; and was because of this wrath upon Israel, and not went up the number in [the] number of [the] matters of the days of the king David.

en.L: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count, and he did not finish; and there was wrath on Israel because of this, and the number did not go up into the account of the matters of the days of King David.
en.B: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count them but did not finish. Because of this, wrath came on Israel, and the number was not entered in the record of the History of King David.
en.R: Joab son of Zeruiah started to count the men, but he did not finish. Because of the count, God's anger came on Israel. So the total was never written down in the history of King David's reign.

es.L: Joab hijo de Sarvia comenzó a contar, y no terminó; y por esto vino ira sobre Israel, y el número no subió a la cuenta de los hechos de los días del rey David.
es.B: Joab hijo de Sarvia comenzó a contarlos, pero no terminó. Por causa de esto vino la ira sobre Israel, y el número no fue anotado en el registro de la Historia del rey David.
es.R: Joab hijo de Sarvia comenzó a contar a los hombres, pero no terminó. Por causa del censo, la ira de Dios cayó sobre Israel. Por eso el total nunca se escribió en la historia del reinado del rey David.

fr.L: Joab, fils de Tserouya, commença à compter, mais il n’acheva pas ; et à cause de cela il y eut de la colère contre Israël, et le nombre ne monta pas dans le compte des actes des jours du roi David.
fr.B: Joab, fils de Tserouya, avait commencé à faire le compte, mais il ne l’acheva pas. À cause de cela, la colère vint sur Israël, et le nombre ne fut pas inscrit dans le registre des Annales du roi David.
fr.R: Joab, fils de Tserouya, a commencé à compter les hommes, mais il n’a pas terminé. À cause de ce recensement, la colère de Dieu est tombée sur Israël. C’est pourquoi le total n’a jamais été écrit dans l’histoire du règne du roi David.

sw.L: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alianza kuhesabu, lakini hakumaliza; na kwa sababu ya hili kukawa na ghadhabu juu ya Israeli, na hesabu haikupanda katika hesabu ya mambo ya siku za mfalme Daudi.
sw.B: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alianza kuwahesabu lakini hakumaliza. Kwa sababu ya hili, ghadhabu ilikuja juu ya Israeli, na hesabu hiyo haikuandikwa katika kumbukumbu za Historia ya Mfalme Daudi.
sw.R: Yoabu mwana wa Seruya alianza kuwahesabu wanaume, lakini hakumaliza. Kwa sababu ya hesabu hiyo, hasira ya Mungu ilikuja juu ya Israeli. Kwa hiyo jumla haikuandikwa kamwe katika historia ya utawala wa mfalme Daudi.

vi.L: Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia bắt đầu kiểm tra, nhưng ông không làm xong; vì việc này mà cơn thịnh nộ giáng trên Y-sơ-ra-ên, và con số không được ghi vào sách ghi chép các việc thời vua Đa-vít.
vi.B: Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia bắt đầu kiểm tra nhưng không làm xong. Vì việc này mà cơn thịnh nộ giáng trên Y-sơ-ra-ên, và con số ấy không được ghi vào Sách Lịch Sử Vua Đa-vít.
vi.R: Giô-áp con trai Xê-ru-gia bắt đầu đếm, nhưng ông không đếm xong. Vì việc đếm dân này mà cơn giận của Đức Chúa Trời giáng trên Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vì vậy tổng số không bao giờ được ghi vào sách lịch sử triều vua Đa-vít.

ko.L: 스루야의 아들 요압이 세기 시작했으나 마치지 못했다. 그리고 이 일 때문에 이스라엘에 진노가 [내렸고], 그 수는 다윗 왕의 날들의 일들을 적은 기록에 오르지 않았다.
ko.B: 스루야의 아들 요압이 세기 시작했으나 끝내지 못했다. 이 일 때문에 이스라엘에 진노가 내렸고, 그 수는 다윗 왕 실록에 오르지 않았다.
ko.R: 스루야의 아들 요압이 남자들을 세기 시작했지만 끝내지 못했다. 그 일 때문에 하나님의 진노가 이스라엘에 내렸다. 그래서 그 수는 다윗 왕의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되지 않았다.

pt.L: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, começou a contar, e não terminou; e houve ira sobre Israel por causa disso, e o número não subiu ao registro das crônicas do rei Davi.
pt.B: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, começou a contá-los, mas não terminou. Por causa disso, veio ira sobre Israel, e o número não foi lançado no registro das Crônicas do Rei Davi.
pt.R: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, começou a contar os homens, mas não terminou. Por causa dessa contagem, a ira de Deus caiu sobre Israel. Por isso o total nunca foi escrito na história do reinado do rei Davi.

decisions.choice: Joab began to count but did not finish; wrath came: the census of chapter 21
decisions.reason: This is the count David ordered in 21:1-6, which Joab carried out against his will and left unfinished, not counting Levi and Benjamin (21:6). God was displeased and struck Israel with a plague (21:7, 14; 2 Samuel 24:1, 15).

decisions.choice: wrath: God's anger against the census
decisions.reason: The word is used for God's anger at sin (Numbers 1:53; 18:5). The verse does not name God, but chapter 21 shows that the anger was his.

decisions.choice: the account of the matters of the days of King David: the royal record of David's reign
decisions.reason: This is the kind of official court record that Kings and Chronicles cite as a source (1 Kings 14:19). Here the word for "number" or "account" stands where those formulas have "book", and the record is David's own. It has not survived, and it is not the biblical book of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: the record of the History of King David (Balanced); the history of King David's reign (Readable)
decisions.reason: The source formula is "the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel" at Balanced and "the history of the kings of Israel" at Readable (1 Kings 14:19). It is adapted here: "record" for the Hebrew word "account", and King David in place of the kings of Israel.

decisions.choice: the men; God's anger
decisions.reason: Readable says who was counted and whose anger it was (m2).

decisions.choice: la cuenta de los hechos de los días del rey David (L); el registro de la Historia del rey David (B); la historia del reinado del rey David (R)
decisions.reason: The royal record is named after the pattern of the source formulas in the Kings note, kept apart from the Spanish title of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "le registre des Annales du roi David" (B); "l’histoire du règne du roi David" (R)
decisions.reason: The royal record is named as the Kings terms note names the kings’ sources ("les Annales"), so it is not confused with the title of the book of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: hesabu ya mambo ya siku za mfalme Daudi (L); kumbukumbu za Historia ya Mfalme Daudi (B); historia ya utawala wa mfalme Daudi (R)
decisions.reason: The royal record follows the pattern the terms note sets for the book of the kings ("Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme"), so it is not confused with the Swahili title of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "sách ghi chép các việc thời vua Đa-vít" (L); "Sách Lịch Sử Vua Đa-vít" (B); "sách lịch sử triều vua Đa-vít" (R)
decisions.reason: The pattern of the Kings sources formula, kept apart from "Sử Ký", the title of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "다윗 왕의 날들의 일들을 적은 기록" (L); "다윗 왕 실록" (B); "다윗 왕의 역사를 적은 책" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's source formula ("이스라엘 왕 실록" at Balanced), adapted to King David, as the English adapts it.

decisions.choice: o registro das crônicas do rei Davi (L); o registro das Crônicas do Rei Davi (B); a história do reinado do rei Davi (R)
decisions.reason: The court record (m3) takes the words of the source note of 1 Kings 14:19 in Portuguese, "o livro das crônicas" (L), "o Livro das Crônicas" (B, with capitals as a title), "a história" (R), with "registro" for the Hebrew "number" where Kings has "book", as the English (r-en-1). "Contar" is the verb of the census in 2 Samuel 24 and 21:1-6 (m1).

source.text: וְעַל֙ אֹצְר֣וֹת הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַזְמָ֖וֶת בֶּן־עֲדִיאֵ֑לסוְעַ֣ל הָֽאֹצָר֡וֹת בַּשָּׂדֶ֞ה בֶּעָרִ֤ים וּבַכְּפָרִים֙ וּבַמִּגְדָּל֔וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן בֶּן־עֻזִּיָּֽהוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And over [the] treasuries of the king [was] Azmaveth son of Adiel; and over the treasuries in the field, in the cities and in the villages and in the towers, [was] Jonathan son of Uzziah.

en.L: And over the treasuries of the king [was] Azmaveth son of Adiel; and over the treasuries in the field, in the cities and in the villages and in the towers, [was] Jonathan son of Uzziah.
en.B: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the king's treasuries. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses out in the country, in the towns, in the villages and in the towers.
en.R: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the king's treasures. The storehouses in the countryside, the towns, the villages and the watchtowers were under Jonathan son of Uzziah.

es.L: Y sobre los tesoros del rey [estaba] Azmavet hijo de Adiel; y sobre los tesoros del campo, en las ciudades y en las aldeas y en las torres, [estaba] Jonatán hijo de Uzías.
es.B: Azmavet hijo de Adiel estaba a cargo de los tesoros del rey. Jonatán hijo de Uzías estaba a cargo de los almacenes del campo, de las ciudades, de las aldeas y de las torres.
es.R: Azmavet hijo de Adiel estaba a cargo de los tesoros del rey. Los almacenes del campo, de las ciudades, de las aldeas y de las torres de vigilancia estaban bajo el cuidado de Jonatán hijo de Uzías.

fr.L: Et sur les trésors du roi [était] Azmaveth, fils d’Adiel ; et sur les trésors dans les campagnes, dans les villes, et dans les villages, et dans les tours, [était] Jonathan, fils d’Ouzziya.
fr.B: Azmaveth, fils d’Adiel, avait la charge des trésors du roi. Jonathan, fils d’Ouzziya, avait la charge des réserves dans les campagnes, dans les villes, dans les villages et dans les tours.
fr.R: Azmaveth, fils d’Adiel, était responsable des trésors du roi. Les réserves des campagnes, des villes, des villages et des tours de garde étaient sous la responsabilité de Jonathan, fils d’Ouzziya.

sw.L: Na juu ya hazina za mfalme [alikuwa] Azmawethi mwana wa Adieli; na juu ya hazina katika mashamba, katika miji na katika vijiji na katika minara, [alikuwa] Yonathani mwana wa Uzia.
sw.B: Azmawethi mwana wa Adieli alisimamia hazina za mfalme. Yonathani mwana wa Uzia alisimamia ghala za mashambani, mijini, vijijini na katika minara.
sw.R: Azmawethi mwana wa Adieli alisimamia mali ya mfalme. Ghala za mashambani, za mijini, za vijijini na za minara ya ulinzi zilikuwa chini ya Yonathani mwana wa Uzia.

vi.L: Cai quản các kho báu của vua [là] Ách-ma-vết con trai A-đi-ên; cai quản các kho ở ngoài đồng, trong các thành, trong các làng và trong các tháp, [là] Giô-na-than con trai U-xi-a.
vi.B: Ách-ma-vết con trai A-đi-ên coi sóc các kho báu của vua. Giô-na-than con trai U-xi-a coi sóc các kho ở ngoài đồng, trong các thành, các làng và các tháp canh.
vi.R: Ách-ma-vết con trai A-đi-ên coi sóc của cải của vua. Các kho ở vùng thôn quê, trong các thành, các làng và các tháp canh do Giô-na-than con trai U-xi-a coi sóc.

ko.L: 그리고 왕의 곳간들 위에는 아디엘의 아들 아스마웻[이 있었고], 들과 성읍들과 마을들과 망대들에 있는 곳간들 위에는 웃시야의 아들 요나단[이 있었다].
ko.B: 아디엘의 아들 아스마웻은 왕의 보물 창고를 맡았고, 웃시야의 아들 요나단은 들과 성읍과 마을과 망대에 있는 창고들을 맡았다.
ko.R: 아디엘의 아들 아스마웻은 왕의 보물을 맡았다. 시골과 성읍과 마을과 망대에 있는 창고들은 웃시야의 아들 요나단이 맡았다.

pt.L: E sobre os tesouros do rei [estava] Azmavete, filho de Adiel; e sobre os tesouros no campo, nas cidades, e nas aldeias, e nas torres, [estava] Jônatas, filho de Uzias.
pt.B: Azmavete, filho de Adiel, era o encarregado dos tesouros do rei. Jônatas, filho de Uzias, era o encarregado dos armazéns no campo, nas cidades, nas aldeias e nas torres.
pt.R: Azmavete, filho de Adiel, cuidava dos tesouros do rei. Os armazéns no interior, nas cidades, nas aldeias e nas torres de vigia ficavam sob as ordens de Jônatas, filho de Uzias.

decisions.choice: treasuries: stores of the king's wealth and goods
decisions.reason: The same word is used for both. The first is the king's own treasury, at the palace; the second is the network of storehouses across the land where produce and supplies were kept (2 Chronicles 32:27-28).

decisions.choice: towers: fortified posts in the countryside
decisions.reason: Towers guarded farmland and herds and served as stores (2 Chronicles 26:10; 27:4).

decisions.choice: the king's stewards: verses 25-31
decisions.reason: The list now turns from the army and the tribes to the men who managed the king's own lands, crops and animals (verse 31).

decisions.choice: treasuries ... storehouses (Balanced); treasures ... storehouses (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one word for the one Hebrew word. Balanced and Readable use "storehouses" for the stores across the countryside (m1).

decisions.choice: [estava] sobre (L); era o encarregado de (B); cuidava de, era o encarregado de (R); os tesouros ... os armazéns (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the stewards of verses 25-31 (m3), the wording of the officials' lists of 1 Kings 4:5-6 in Portuguese: "[estava] sobre" at Literal, "era o encarregado" at Balanced. Literal keeps one word, "tesouros", for the one Hebrew word; Balanced and Readable say "armazéns" for the stores across the country (m1), as the English (r-en-1).

source.text: וְעַ֗ל עֹשֵׂי֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה עֶזְרִ֖י בֶּן־כְּלֽוּב׃

records.literal_gloss: And over [the] doers of [the] work of the field for [the] labor of the ground [was] Ezri son of Chelub.

en.L: And over the doers of the work of the field, for the labor of the ground, [was] Ezri son of Chelub.
en.B: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the field workers who farmed the land.
en.R: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.

es.L: Y sobre los que hacían la obra del campo, para la labranza de la tierra, [estaba] Ezri hijo de Quelub.
es.B: Ezri hijo de Quelub estaba a cargo de los trabajadores del campo que cultivaban la tierra.
es.R: Ezri hijo de Quelub estaba a cargo de los trabajadores que cultivaban las tierras del rey.

fr.L: Et sur ceux qui faisaient l’ouvrage des champs, pour le travail de la terre, [était] Ezri, fils de Keloub.
fr.B: Ezri, fils de Keloub, avait la charge des ouvriers agricoles qui cultivaient la terre.
fr.R: Ezri, fils de Keloub, était responsable des ouvriers qui cultivaient les terres du roi.

sw.L: Na juu ya watenda kazi ya shamba, kwa ajili ya kulima ardhi, [alikuwa] Ezri mwana wa Kelubu.
sw.B: Ezri mwana wa Kelubu alisimamia wafanyakazi wa mashambani waliolima ardhi.
sw.R: Ezri mwana wa Kelubu alisimamia wafanyakazi waliolima mashamba ya mfalme.

vi.L: Cai quản những người làm công việc đồng áng để cày cấy đất đai [là] Ết-ri con trai Kê-lúp.
vi.B: Ết-ri con trai Kê-lúp coi sóc những người làm ruộng cày cấy đất đai.
vi.R: Ết-ri con trai Kê-lúp coi sóc những người cày cấy ruộng đất của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 땅을 가는 들일을 하는 자들 위에는 글룹의 아들 에스리[가 있었다].
ko.B: 글룹의 아들 에스리는 땅을 가는 농부들을 맡았다.
ko.R: 글룹의 아들 에스리는 왕의 땅에서 농사짓는 일꾼들을 맡았다.

pt.L: E sobre os que faziam o trabalho do campo, para o cultivo da terra, [estava] Ezri, filho de Quelube.
pt.B: Ezri, filho de Quelube, era o encarregado dos trabalhadores do campo, que cultivavam a terra.
pt.R: Ezri, filho de Quelube, era o encarregado dos trabalhadores que cultivavam as terras do rei.

decisions.choice: the doers of the work of the field for the labor of the ground: the farm workers
decisions.reason: The phrase describes the men who worked the royal farmland, plowing and sowing.

decisions.choice: the king's land
decisions.reason: Readable says whose land it was; the whole list is of King David's property (verse 31).

source.text: וְעַל־הַ֨כְּרָמִ֔ים שִׁמְעִ֖י הָרָֽמָתִ֑י וְעַ֤ל שֶׁבַּכְּרָמִים֙ לְאֹצְר֣וֹת הַיַּ֔יִן זַבְדִּ֖י הַשִּׁפְמִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And over the vineyards [was] Shimei the Ramathite; and over what [was] in the vineyards for [the] storehouses of the wine [was] Zabdi the Shiphmite.

en.L: And over the vineyards [was] Shimei the Ramathite; and over what [was] in the vineyards, for the storehouses of the wine, [was] Zabdi the Shiphmite.
en.B: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the vineyards' yield for the wine cellars.
en.R: Shimei the Ramathite looked after the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was responsible for storing the wine they produced.

es.L: Y sobre las viñas [estaba] Simei el ramatita; y sobre lo que [había] en las viñas para las bodegas del vino [estaba] Zabdi el sifmita.
es.B: Simei el ramatita estaba a cargo de las viñas, y Zabdi el sifmita estaba a cargo del producto de las viñas para las bodegas de vino.
es.R: Simei el ramatita cuidaba de las viñas. Zabdi el sifmita era responsable de guardar el vino que producían.

fr.L: Et sur les vignes [était] Shiméï le Ramatite ; et sur ce qui [était] dans les vignes, pour les réserves de vin, [était] Zabdi le Shiphmite.
fr.B: Shiméï le Ramatite avait la charge des vignes, et Zabdi le Shiphmite celle du produit des vignes pour les caves à vin.
fr.R: Shiméï le Ramatite s’occupait des vignes. Zabdi le Shiphmite était responsable de la réserve du vin qu’elles produisaient.

sw.L: Na juu ya mashamba ya mizabibu [alikuwa] Shimei Mramathi; na juu ya yaliyokuwa katika mashamba ya mizabibu, kwa ajili ya ghala za divai, [alikuwa] Zabdi Mshifmi.
sw.B: Shimei Mramathi alisimamia mashamba ya mizabibu, na Zabdi Mshifmi alisimamia mazao ya mizabibu kwa ajili ya ghala za divai.
sw.R: Shimei Mramathi alitunza mashamba ya mizabibu. Zabdi Mshifmi alihusika na kuhifadhi divai iliyotokana nayo.

vi.L: Cai quản các vườn nho [là] Si-mê-i người Ra-ma; cai quản sản vật trong các vườn nho cho các kho rượu [là] Xáp-đi người Síp-mi.
vi.B: Si-mê-i người Ra-ma coi sóc các vườn nho, còn Xáp-đi người Síp-mi coi sóc hoa lợi của các vườn nho cho các hầm rượu.
vi.R: Si-mê-i người Ra-ma trông nom các vườn nho. Xáp-đi người Síp-mi lo việc cất giữ rượu làm từ các vườn nho ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 포도원들 위에는 라마 사람 시므이[가 있었고], 포도원에서 난 것, 곧 포도주 곳간들 위에는 스밤 사람 삽디[가 있었다].
ko.B: 라마 사람 시므이는 포도원을 맡았고, 스밤 사람 삽디는 포도원에서 나는 것을 포도주 창고에 두는 일을 맡았다.
ko.R: 라마 사람 시므이는 포도원들을 돌보았다. 스밤 사람 삽디는 포도원에서 만든 포도주를 저장하는 일을 맡았다.

pt.L: E sobre as vinhas [estava] Simei, o ramatita; e sobre o que [havia] nas vinhas para os depósitos do vinho [estava] Zabdi, o sifmita.
pt.B: Simei, o ramatita, era o encarregado das vinhas, e Zabdi, o sifmita, era o encarregado da produção das vinhas para as adegas.
pt.R: Simei, o ramatita, cuidava das vinhas. Zabdi, o sifmita, era responsável por guardar o vinho que elas produziam.

decisions.choice: what was in the vineyards for the storehouses of wine: the grapes and wine to be stored
decisions.reason: One man oversaw the vines; another oversaw their yield, the wine that went into the king's stores.

decisions.choice: the Ramathite, the Shiphmite: named by their home towns
decisions.reason: A Ramathite came from Ramah, a name several towns bore. Shiphmite may refer to Shepham (Numbers 34:10-11), or to another place now unknown.

decisions.choice: wine cellars (Balanced); storing the wine (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Storehouses of wine" said in plain words.

source.text: וְעַל־הַזֵּיתִ֤ים וְהַשִּׁקְמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֔ה בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן הַגְּדֵרִ֑יסוְעַל־אֹצְר֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן יוֹעָֽשׁ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And over the olive trees and the sycamores that [were] in the Shephelah [was] Baal-hanan the Gederite; and over [the] storehouses of the oil [was] Joash.

en.L: And over the olive trees and the sycamores that [were] in the Shephelah [was] Baal-hanan the Gederite; and over the storehouses of the oil [was] Joash.
en.B: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive trees and the sycamore-fig trees in the Shephelah, and Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.
en.R: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive trees and the fig trees in the western foothills. Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.

es.L: Y sobre los olivos y los sicómoros que [había] en la Sefela [estaba] Baal-hanán el gederita; y sobre los almacenes del aceite [estaba] Joás.
es.B: Baal-hanán el gederita estaba a cargo de los olivos y los sicómoros de la Sefela, y Joás estaba a cargo de las reservas de aceite.
es.R: Baal-hanán el gederita estaba a cargo de los olivos y de las higueras de las colinas del oeste. Joás estaba a cargo de guardar el aceite de oliva.

fr.L: Et sur les oliviers et les sycomores qui [étaient] dans la Shéféla [était] Baal-Hanân le Guedérite ; et sur les réserves d’huile [était] Joas.
fr.B: Baal-Hanân le Guedérite avait la charge des oliviers et des sycomores de la Shéféla, et Joas celle des réserves d’huile.
fr.R: Baal-Hanân le Guedérite était responsable des oliviers et des figuiers dans les collines de l’ouest. Joas était responsable de la réserve d’huile d’olive.

sw.L: Na juu ya mizeituni na mikuyu iliyokuwa katika Shefela [alikuwa] Baal-hanani Mgederi; na juu ya ghala za mafuta [alikuwa] Yoashi.
sw.B: Baal-hanani Mgederi alisimamia mizeituni na mikuyu katika Shefela, na Yoashi alisimamia akiba ya mafuta ya zeituni.
sw.R: Baal-hanani Mgederi alisimamia mizeituni na mitini katika vilima vya magharibi. Yoashi alihusika na kuhifadhi mafuta ya zeituni.

vi.L: Cai quản các cây ô-liu và cây sung ở vùng Sơ-phê-la [là] Ba-anh Ha-nan người Ghê-đe; cai quản các kho dầu [là] Giô-ách.
vi.B: Ba-anh Ha-nan người Ghê-đe coi sóc các cây ô-liu và cây sung ở vùng Sơ-phê-la, còn Giô-ách coi sóc các kho dầu ô-liu.
vi.R: Ba-anh Ha-nan người Ghê-đe coi sóc các cây ô-liu và cây sung ở vùng đồi thấp phía tây. Giô-ách lo việc cất giữ dầu ô-liu.

ko.L: 그리고 세펠라에 있는 올리브나무와 돌무화과나무 위에는 게델 사람 바알하난[이 있었고], 기름 곳간들 위에는 요아스[가 있었다].
ko.B: 게델 사람 바알하난은 세펠라에 있는 올리브나무와 돌무화과나무를 맡았고, 요아스는 올리브기름 창고를 맡았다.
ko.R: 게델 사람 바알하난은 서쪽 낮은 산지에 있는 올리브나무와 무화과나무를 맡았다. 요아스는 올리브기름을 저장하는 일을 맡았다.

pt.L: E sobre as oliveiras e os sicômoros que [havia] na Sefelá [estava] Baal-Hanã, o gederita; e sobre os depósitos do azeite [estava] Joás.
pt.B: Baal-Hanã, o gederita, era o encarregado das oliveiras e dos sicômoros das colinas da Sefelá, e Joás era o encarregado dos depósitos de azeite.
pt.R: Baal-Hanã, o gederita, era o encarregado das oliveiras e das figueiras que cresciam nas colinas do oeste. Joás era o encarregado de guardar o azeite.

decisions.choice: sycamores: the sycamore-fig, grown for its fruit and wood
decisions.reason: This tree is a kind of fig, not the sycamore of Europe or America. It grew plentifully in the low hills (1 Kings 10:27), and its fruit and timber were valuable (Amos 7:14; Isaiah 9:9).

decisions.choice: the Shephelah: the low hills between Judah's hill country and the coastal plain
decisions.reason: The name means "lowland". It was good land for olives and figs.

decisions.choice: sycamore-fig trees, the Shephelah (Balanced); fig trees, the western foothills (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 10:27.

decisions.choice: "세펠라", "돌무화과나무" (L, B); "서쪽 낮은 산지", "무화과나무" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Korean of 1 Kings 10:27.

decisions.choice: os sicômoros, a Sefelá (L); os sicômoros das colinas da Sefelá (B); as figueiras ... nas colinas do oeste (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 10:27 in Portuguese, level by level: "sicômoro" already names the sycamore fig (m1), so Balanced needs no compound as the English does, and Readable says where the low hills lie (m2).

source.text: וְעַל־הַבָּקָר֙ הָרֹעִ֣ים בַּשָּׁר֔וֹן שִׁרְטַ֖י הַשָּׁרוֹנִ֑י וְעַל־הַבָּקָר֙ בָּֽעֲמָקִ֔ים שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן־עַדְלָֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And over the cattle grazing in Sharon [was] Shitrai the Sharonite; and over the cattle in the valleys [was] Shaphat son of Adlai.

en.L: And over the cattle that grazed in Sharon [was] Shitrai the Sharonite; and over the cattle in the valleys [was] Shaphat son of Adlai.
en.B: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds that grazed in Sharon, and Shaphat son of Adlai over the herds in the valleys.
en.R: Shitrai from Sharon was in charge of the cattle that grazed in the plain of Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the cattle in the valleys.

es.L: Y sobre el ganado que pastaba en Sarón [estaba] Sitrai el saronita; y sobre el ganado de los valles [estaba] Safat hijo de Adlai.
es.B: Sitrai el saronita estaba a cargo del ganado que pastaba en Sarón, y Safat hijo de Adlai del ganado de los valles.
es.R: Sitrai, de Sarón, estaba a cargo del ganado que pastaba en la llanura de Sarón. Safat hijo de Adlai estaba a cargo del ganado de los valles.

fr.L: Et sur le gros bétail qui paissait dans le Saron [était] Shitraï le Saronite ; et sur le gros bétail dans les vallées [était] Shaphath, fils d’Adlaï.
fr.B: Shitraï le Saronite avait la charge des troupeaux qui paissaient dans le Saron, et Shaphath, fils d’Adlaï, celle des troupeaux des vallées.
fr.R: Shitraï, du Saron, était responsable des bœufs qui paissaient dans la plaine du Saron. Shaphath, fils d’Adlaï, était responsable des bœufs dans les vallées.

sw.L: Na juu ya ng'ombe waliochunga katika Sharoni [alikuwa] Shitrai Msharoni; na juu ya ng'ombe katika mabonde [alikuwa] Shafati mwana wa Adlai.
sw.B: Shitrai Msharoni alisimamia makundi ya ng'ombe yaliyochunga Sharoni, na Shafati mwana wa Adlai alisimamia makundi ya ng'ombe mabondeni.
sw.R: Shitrai wa Sharoni alisimamia ng'ombe waliochunga katika uwanda wa Sharoni. Shafati mwana wa Adlai alisimamia ng'ombe waliokuwa mabondeni.

vi.L: Cai quản bò chăn ở Sa-rôn [là] Sít-rai người Sa-rôn; cai quản bò trong các thung lũng [là] Sa-phát con trai Át-lai.
vi.B: Sít-rai người Sa-rôn coi sóc các đàn bò chăn ở Sa-rôn, còn Sa-phát con trai Át-lai coi sóc các đàn bò trong các thung lũng.
vi.R: Sít-rai người Sa-rôn coi sóc các đàn bò ăn cỏ ở đồng bằng Sa-rôn. Sa-phát con trai Át-lai coi sóc các đàn bò trong các thung lũng.

ko.L: 그리고 사론에서 풀을 뜯는 소 떼 위에는 사론 사람 시드래[가 있었고], 골짜기들에 있는 소 떼 위에는 아들래의 아들 사밧[이 있었다].
ko.B: 사론 사람 시드래는 사론에서 풀을 뜯는 소 떼를 맡았고, 아들래의 아들 사밧은 골짜기에 있는 소 떼를 맡았다.
ko.R: 사론 출신 시드래는 사론 평야에서 풀을 뜯는 소 떼를 맡았다. 아들래의 아들 사밧은 골짜기에 있는 소 떼를 맡았다.

pt.L: E sobre o gado que pastava em Sarom [estava] Sitrai, o saronita; e sobre o gado nos vales [estava] Safate, filho de Adlai.
pt.B: Sitrai, o saronita, era o encarregado do gado que pastava em Sarom, e Safate, filho de Adlai, do gado dos vales.
pt.R: Sitrai, de Sarom, era o encarregado do gado que pastava na planície de Sarom. Safate, filho de Adlai, era o encarregado do gado nos vales.

decisions.choice: Shitrai: the reading the scribes marked to be read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew letters give the name as Shirtai; the scribes' marginal note reads Shitrai. The two differ only in the order of two letters. The spoken reading is followed.

decisions.choice: Sharon: the coastal plain north of Joppa
decisions.reason: Sharon was rich pastureland (Isaiah 65:10).

decisions.choice: the plain of Sharon
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of place Sharon was.

source.text: וְעַל־הַ֨גְּמַלִּ֔ים אוֹבִ֖יל הַיִּשְׁמְעֵלִ֑י וְעַל־הָ֣אֲתֹנ֔וֹת יֶחְדְּיָ֖הוּ הַמֵּרֹנֹתִֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And over the camels [was] Obil the Ishmaelite; and over the female donkeys [was] Jehdeiah the Meronothite.

en.L: And over the camels [was] Obil the Ishmaelite; and over the female donkeys [was] Jehdeiah the Meronothite.
en.B: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, and Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
en.R: Obil the Ishmaelite looked after the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite looked after the donkeys.

es.L: Y sobre los camellos [estaba] Obil el ismaelita; y sobre las asnas [estaba] Jehedías el meronotita.
es.B: Obil el ismaelita estaba a cargo de los camellos, y Jehedías el meronotita estaba a cargo de las asnas.
es.R: Obil el ismaelita cuidaba de los camellos. Jehedías el meronotita cuidaba de los asnos.

fr.L: Et sur les chameaux [était] Obil l’Ismaélite ; et sur les ânesses [était] Yehdeya le Méronothite.
fr.B: Obil l’Ismaélite avait la charge des chameaux, et Yehdeya le Méronothite celle des ânesses.
fr.R: Obil l’Ismaélite s’occupait des chameaux. Yehdeya le Méronothite s’occupait des ânesses.

sw.L: Na juu ya ngamia [alikuwa] Obili Mwishmaeli; na juu ya punda wa kike [alikuwa] Yehdeya Mmeronothi.
sw.B: Obili Mwishmaeli alisimamia ngamia, na Yehdeya Mmeronothi alisimamia punda.
sw.R: Obili Mwishmaeli alitunza ngamia. Yehdeya Mmeronothi alitunza punda.

vi.L: Cai quản lạc đà [là] Ô-binh người Ích-ma-ên; cai quản lừa cái [là] Giê-đia người Mê-rô-nốt.
vi.B: Ô-binh người Ích-ma-ên coi sóc lạc đà, còn Giê-đia người Mê-rô-nốt coi sóc đàn lừa.
vi.R: Ô-binh người Ích-ma-ên trông nom lạc đà. Giê-đia người Mê-rô-nốt trông nom lừa.

ko.L: 그리고 낙타들 위에는 이스마엘 사람 오빌[이 있었고], 암나귀들 위에는 메로놋 사람 예드야[가 있었다].
ko.B: 이스마엘 사람 오빌은 낙타를 맡았고, 메로놋 사람 예드야는 나귀를 맡았다.
ko.R: 이스마엘 사람 오빌은 낙타들을 돌보았다. 메로놋 사람 예드야는 나귀들을 돌보았다.

pt.L: E sobre os camelos [estava] Obil, o ismaelita; e sobre as jumentas [estava] Jedias, o meronotita.
pt.B: Obil, o ismaelita, era o encarregado dos camelos, e Jedias, o meronotita, dos jumentos.
pt.R: Obil, o ismaelita, cuidava dos camelos. Jedias, o meronotita, cuidava dos jumentos.

decisions.choice: Obil the Ishmaelite: a man from a people known for camels
decisions.reason: The Ishmaelites were desert traders who traveled with camels (Genesis 37:25). An Ishmaelite was a fitting choice to keep the king's camels.

decisions.choice: female donkeys: the donkeys kept for breeding and milk
decisions.reason: The word means she-donkeys, the most valued part of a herd (Job 1:3; 42:12).

decisions.choice: the donkeys
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say simply "donkeys"; Literal keeps "female".

source.text: וְעַל־הַצֹּ֖אן יָזִ֣יז הַֽהַגְרִ֑י כָּל־אֵ֨לֶּה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרְכ֔וּשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And over the flock [was] Jaziz the Hagrite. All these [were] officials of the property that [belonged] to the king David.

en.L: And over the flock [was] Jaziz the Hagrite. All these [were] princes of the property that [belonged] to King David.
en.B: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these were the officials in charge of King David's property.
en.R: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats. All these men managed the property that belonged to King David.

es.L: Y sobre el rebaño [estaba] Jaziz el agareno. Todos estos [eran] príncipes de la hacienda que [era] del rey David.
es.B: Jaziz el agareno estaba a cargo de los rebaños. Todos estos eran los oficiales a cargo de la hacienda del rey David.
es.R: Jaziz el agareno estaba a cargo de las ovejas y las cabras. Todos estos hombres administraban los bienes que pertenecían al rey David.

fr.L: Et sur le petit bétail [était] Yaziz le Hagrite. Tous ceux-là [étaient] les intendants des biens qui [appartenaient] au roi David.
fr.B: Yaziz le Hagrite avait la charge du petit bétail. Tous ceux-là étaient les intendants des biens du roi David.
fr.R: Yaziz le Hagrite était responsable des moutons et des chèvres. Tous ces hommes géraient les biens qui appartenaient au roi David.

sw.L: Na juu ya kundi [la kondoo na mbuzi] [alikuwa] Yazizi Mhagri. Hawa wote [walikuwa] wakuu wa mali iliyokuwa ya mfalme Daudi.
sw.B: Yazizi Mhagri alisimamia makundi ya kondoo na mbuzi. Hawa wote walikuwa maafisa waliosimamia mali ya mfalme Daudi.
sw.R: Yazizi Mhagri alisimamia kondoo na mbuzi. Watu hawa wote waliisimamia mali iliyokuwa ya mfalme Daudi.

vi.L: Cai quản bầy chiên [là] Gia-xít người Ha-ga. Tất cả những người này [là] các quan cai quản tài sản thuộc về vua Đa-vít.
vi.B: Gia-xít người Ha-ga coi sóc các bầy chiên dê. Tất cả những người này là các quan chức coi sóc tài sản của vua Đa-vít.
vi.R: Gia-xít người Ha-ga coi sóc các bầy chiên dê. Tất cả những người này quản lý tài sản thuộc về vua Đa-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 양 떼 위에는 하갈 사람 야시스[가 있었다]. 이들은 모두 다윗 왕에게 속한 재산의 고관들이었다.
ko.B: 하갈 사람 야시스는 양 떼를 맡았다. 이들은 모두 다윗 왕의 재산을 맡은 관리들이었다.
ko.R: 하갈 사람 야시스는 양과 염소 떼를 맡았다. 이 사람들이 모두 다윗 왕의 재산을 관리했다.

pt.L: E sobre o rebanho [estava] Jaziz, o hagareno. Todos esses [eram] príncipes dos bens que [pertenciam] ao rei Davi.
pt.B: Jaziz, o hagareno, era o encarregado dos rebanhos. Todos esses eram os oficiais encarregados dos bens do rei Davi.
pt.R: Jaziz, o hagareno, era o encarregado das ovelhas e das cabras. Todos esses homens administravam os bens que pertenciam ao rei Davi.

decisions.choice: Jaziz the Hagrite: from a people of the eastern desert
decisions.reason: The Hagrites were herders east of Gilead, defeated by the eastern tribes in Saul's day (5:10, 19-22). Like Obil (verse 30), this herdsman was not an Israelite.

decisions.choice: officials: officers in charge
decisions.reason: The word, often "princes", is the general title for an official under the king. Here it names the stewards over the royal property.

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); managed (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "princes" for this word, as elsewhere (28:1); the word names men of rank under the king, here the stewards of his property (m2). Balanced says "officials", and Readable says what they did.

decisions.choice: the sheep and goats
decisions.reason: The word for "flock" covers both sheep and goats.

decisions.choice: o hagareno; príncipes (L), os oficiais (B), administravam (R)
decisions.reason: "Hagareno" as 5:10 sets the people's name for the whole book (m1). The title keeps "príncipes" at Literal, as in verse 22, and follows the English at Balanced and Readable (r-en-1).

source.text: וִֽיהוֹנָתָ֤ן דּוֹד־דָּוִיד֙ יוֹעֵ֔ץ אִישׁ־מֵבִ֥ין וְסוֹפֵ֖ר ה֑וּא וִֽיחִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־חַכְמוֹנִ֖י עִם־בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And Jonathan uncle of David [was a] counselor, [a] man understanding, and [a] scribe [was] he; and Jehiel son of Hachmoni [was] with the sons of the king.

en.L: And Jonathan, David's uncle, [was] a counselor, a man of understanding, and he [was] a scribe; and Jehiel son of Hachmoni [was] with the king's sons.
en.B: Jonathan, David's uncle, was a counselor; he was a man of understanding and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended the king's sons.
en.R: Jonathan, David's uncle, was an adviser to the king. He was a wise man and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni took care of the king's sons.

es.L: Y Jonatán, tío de David, [era] consejero, hombre entendido, y él [era] escriba; y Jehiel hijo de Hacmoni [estaba] con los hijos del rey.
es.B: Jonatán, tío de David, era consejero; era un hombre entendido y escriba. Jehiel hijo de Hacmoni atendía a los hijos del rey.
es.R: Jonatán, el tío de David, era consejero del rey. Era un hombre sabio y escriba. Jehiel hijo de Hacmoni cuidaba de los hijos del rey.

fr.L: Et Jonathan, oncle de David, [était] conseiller, homme d’intelligence, et il [était] scribe ; et Yehiel, fils de Hakmoni, [était] avec les fils du roi.
fr.B: Jonathan, l’oncle de David, était conseiller ; c’était un homme d’intelligence et un scribe. Yehiel, fils de Hakmoni, était auprès des fils du roi.
fr.R: Jonathan, l’oncle de David, conseillait le roi. C’était un homme sage et un scribe. Yehiel, fils de Hakmoni, s’occupait des fils du roi.

sw.L: Na Yonathani, mjomba wa Daudi, [alikuwa] mshauri, mtu wa ufahamu, naye [alikuwa] mwandishi; na Yehieli mwana wa Hakmoni [alikuwa] pamoja na wana wa mfalme.
sw.B: Yonathani, mjomba wa Daudi, alikuwa mshauri; alikuwa mtu wa ufahamu na mwandishi. Yehieli mwana wa Hakmoni aliwahudumia wana wa mfalme.
sw.R: Yonathani, mjomba wa Daudi, alikuwa mshauri wa mfalme. Alikuwa mtu mwenye hekima na mwandishi. Yehieli mwana wa Hakmoni aliwatunza wana wa mfalme.

vi.L: Giô-na-than, chú của Đa-vít, [là] một mưu sĩ, một người thông sáng, và ông [là] một thư ký; Giê-hi-ên con trai Hác-mô-ni [ở] với các con trai vua.
vi.B: Giô-na-than, chú của Đa-vít, là một mưu sĩ; ông là người thông sáng và là một thư ký. Giê-hi-ên con trai Hác-mô-ni phụ trách các con trai vua.
vi.R: Giô-na-than, chú của Đa-vít, là cố vấn của vua. Ông là người khôn ngoan và là một thư ký. Giê-hi-ên con trai Hác-mô-ni chăm sóc các con trai vua.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗의 숙부 요나단은 모사였는데, 명철한 사람이요 서기관이었다. 그리고 학모니의 아들 여히엘은 왕의 아들들과 함께 [있었다].
ko.B: 다윗의 숙부 요나단은 모사였는데, 그는 명철한 사람이었고 서기관이었다. 학모니의 아들 여히엘은 왕자들을 돌보았다.
ko.R: 다윗의 숙부 요나단은 왕의 조언자였다. 그는 지혜로운 사람이었고 서기관이었다. 학모니의 아들 여히엘은 왕의 아들들을 돌보았다.

pt.L: E Jônatas, tio de Davi, [era] conselheiro, homem de entendimento, e escriba ele [era]; e Jeiel, filho de Hacmoni, [estava] com os filhos do rei.
pt.B: Jônatas, tio de Davi, era conselheiro; era homem de entendimento e escriba. Jeiel, filho de Hacmoni, acompanhava os filhos do rei.
pt.R: Jônatas, tio de Davi, era conselheiro do rei. Ele era um homem sábio e um escriba. Jeiel, filho de Hacmoni, cuidava dos filhos do rei.

decisions.choice: uncle: the brother of David's father
decisions.reason: The word usually means a father's brother (1 Samuel 10:14). It can also mean a relative more broadly. A Jonathan son of Shimea, David's nephew, is named in 20:7.

decisions.choice: counselor, scribe: an adviser to the king and a man of learning
decisions.reason: A counselor gave the king advice on what to do (2 Samuel 16:23). A scribe could read and write, and kept records; the word can also name the royal secretary (18:16).

decisions.choice: with the king's sons: their attendant or tutor
decisions.reason: Jehiel was assigned to the king's sons, most likely to care for and teach them.

decisions.choice: attended (Balanced); took care of (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only that he was "with" them; Balanced and Readable say it as a task (m3).

decisions.choice: mjomba
decisions.reason: Swahili names an uncle by side of the family: "mjomba" is a mother's brother, "baba mdogo" or "baba mkubwa" a father's brother. The Hebrew *dod* does not say which; "mjomba" is used as the general word, marked uncertain for a reviewer.

decisions.choice: "chú của Đa-vít"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a father's brother; Vietnamese must say whether he was younger ("chú") or older ("bác") than David's father, and the younger is assumed.

decisions.choice: "숙부"
decisions.reason: Korean must choose among words for a father's brother; "숙부" is the general written word and does not say whether he was older or younger than David's father.

decisions.choice: escriba (every level)
decisions.reason: The English says "scribe" at every level, and the meaning note reads the word here as a man of learning beside a counselor (m2), not the royal secretary of 2 Samuel 8:17, where Portuguese says "escrivão" and "secretário". "Escriba" is the Portuguese word for a learned man who could read and write.

records.literal_gloss: And Ahithophel [was a] counselor to the king; and Hushai the Archite [was the] friend of the king.

en.L: And Ahithophel [was] a counselor to the king; and Hushai the Archite [was] the friend of the king.
en.B: Ahithophel was counselor to the king, and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.
en.R: Ahithophel was the king's adviser. Hushai the Archite was the king's friend, his trusted adviser.

es.L: Y Ahitofel [era] consejero del rey; y Husai el arquita [era] el amigo del rey.
es.B: Ahitofel era consejero del rey, y Husai el arquita era el amigo del rey.
es.R: Ahitofel era el consejero del rey. Husai el arquita era el amigo del rey, su consejero de confianza.

fr.L: Et Ahitofel [était] conseiller du roi ; et Houshaï l’Arkite [était] l’ami du roi.
fr.B: Ahitofel était conseiller du roi, et Houshaï l’Arkite était l’ami du roi.
fr.R: Ahitofel conseillait le roi. Houshaï l’Arkite était l’ami du roi, son conseiller de confiance.

sw.L: Na Ahithofeli [alikuwa] mshauri wa mfalme; na Hushai Mwarki [alikuwa] rafiki wa mfalme.
sw.B: Ahithofeli alikuwa mshauri wa mfalme, na Hushai Mwarki alikuwa rafiki wa mfalme.
sw.R: Ahithofeli alikuwa mshauri wa mfalme. Hushai Mwarki alikuwa rafiki wa mfalme, mshauri wake wa kuaminika.

vi.L: A-hi-tô-phe [là] mưu sĩ của vua; Hu-sai người Ạt-kít [là] bạn của vua.
vi.B: A-hi-tô-phe là mưu sĩ của vua, còn Hu-sai người Ạt-kít là bạn của vua.
vi.R: A-hi-tô-phe là cố vấn của vua. Hu-sai người Ạt-kít là bạn của vua, một cố vấn đáng tin cậy.

ko.L: 그리고 아히도벨은 왕의 모사[였고], 아렉 사람 후새는 왕의 벗[이었다].
ko.B: 아히도벨은 왕의 모사였고, 아렉 사람 후새는 왕의 벗이었다.
ko.R: 아히도벨은 왕의 조언자였다. 아렉 사람 후새는 왕의 벗으로, 왕이 깊이 믿는 조언자였다.

pt.L: E Aitofel [era] conselheiro do rei; e Husai, o arquita, [era] o amigo do rei.
pt.B: Aitofel era conselheiro do rei, e Husai, o arquita, era o amigo do rei.
pt.R: Aitofel era o conselheiro do rei. Husai, o arquita, era o amigo do rei, alguém em quem ele confiava.

decisions.choice: Ahithophel the king's counselor: as in 2 Samuel 15:12
decisions.reason: Ahithophel of Giloh is called "David's counselor" in 2 Samuel 15:12. His advice was treated like a word from God (2 Samuel 16:23), but he joined Absalom's revolt and, when his advice was not followed, took his own life (2 Samuel 17:23).

decisions.choice: the friend of the king: a court title for the king's confidant
decisions.reason: "The king's friend" was a position at court, a trusted adviser (1 Kings 4:5). Hushai is "David's friend" in 2 Samuel 15:37 and 16:16, where he defeated Ahithophel's advice (2 Samuel 17:14).

decisions.choice: the Archite: from the Archite clan near Bethel
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 15:32; the Archites lived on the border of Ephraim and Benjamin (Joshua 16:2).

decisions.choice: his trusted adviser
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title "the king's friend" meant (m2).

decisions.choice: adviser
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 15:12, Readable says "adviser" for "counselor".

decisions.choice: Aitofel; Husai, o arquita; o amigo do rei
decisions.reason: The names of 2 Samuel 15:12 and 15:32 in Portuguese (m1, m3), and the court title "amigo do rei" of 1 Kings 4:5 (m2). "Conselheiro" already says "adviser", so Readable keeps it and explains the title in other words than the English, to avoid saying "conselheiro" twice.

source.text: וְאַחֲרֵ֣י אֲחִיתֹ֗פֶל יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן־בְּנָיָ֨הוּ֙ וְאֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְשַׂר־צָבָ֥א לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יוֹאָֽב׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And after Ahithophel [were] Jehoiada son of Benaiah and Abiathar; and [the] commander of [the] army of the king [was] Joab.

en.L: And after Ahithophel [were] Jehoiada son of Benaiah and Abiathar; and the commander of the army of the king [was] Joab.
en.B: After Ahithophel came Jehoiada son of Benaiah and Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the king's army.
en.R: After Ahithophel, Jehoiada son of Benaiah and Abiathar became the king's advisers. Joab was the commander of the king's army.

es.L: Y después de Ahitofel [estaban] Joiada hijo de Benaía y Abiatar; y el jefe del ejército del rey [era] Joab.
es.B: Después de Ahitofel vinieron Joiada hijo de Benaía y Abiatar. Joab era el jefe del ejército del rey.
es.R: Después de Ahitofel, Joiada hijo de Benaía y Abiatar llegaron a ser los consejeros del rey. Joab era el jefe del ejército del rey.

fr.L: Et après Ahitofel [vinrent] Yehoyada, fils de Benaya, et Abiathar ; et le chef de l’armée du roi [était] Joab.
fr.B: Après Ahitofel, il y eut Yehoyada, fils de Benaya, et Abiathar. Joab était le chef de l’armée du roi.
fr.R: Après Ahitofel, Yehoyada, fils de Benaya, et Abiathar sont devenus les conseillers du roi. Joab était le chef de l’armée du roi.

sw.L: Na baada ya Ahithofeli [walikuwa] Yehoyada mwana wa Benaya na Abiathari; na jemadari wa jeshi la mfalme [alikuwa] Yoabu.
sw.B: Baada ya Ahithofeli walikuja Yehoyada mwana wa Benaya na Abiathari. Yoabu alikuwa mkuu wa jeshi la mfalme.
sw.R: Baada ya Ahithofeli, Yehoyada mwana wa Benaya na Abiathari wakawa washauri wa mfalme. Yoabu alikuwa mkuu wa jeshi la mfalme.

vi.L: Sau A-hi-tô-phe [có] Giê-hô-gia-đa con trai Bê-na-gia và A-bi-a-tha; còn tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua [là] Giô-áp.
vi.B: Sau A-hi-tô-phe có Giê-hô-gia-đa con trai Bê-na-gia và A-bi-a-tha. Giô-áp là tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua.
vi.R: Sau A-hi-tô-phe, Giê-hô-gia-đa con trai Bê-na-gia và A-bi-a-tha trở thành cố vấn của vua. Giô-áp là tướng chỉ huy quân đội của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 아히도벨 뒤에는 브나야의 아들 여호야다와 아비아달[이 있었고], 왕의 군대 사령관은 요압[이었다].
ko.B: 아히도벨의 뒤를 이어 브나야의 아들 여호야다와 아비아달이 모사가 되었다. 요압은 왕의 군대 사령관이었다.
ko.R: 아히도벨의 뒤를 이어 브나야의 아들 여호야다와 아비아달이 왕의 조언자가 되었다. 요압은 왕의 군대 사령관이었다.

pt.L: E depois de Aitofel [vieram] Joiada, filho de Benaia, e Abiatar; e o comandante do exército do rei [era] Joabe.
pt.B: Depois de Aitofel vieram Joiada, filho de Benaia, e Abiatar. Joabe era o comandante do exército do rei.
pt.R: Depois de Aitofel, Joiada, filho de Benaia, e Abiatar passaram a ser os conselheiros do rei. Joabe era o comandante do exército do rei.

decisions.choice: after Ahithophel: they succeeded him as counselors
decisions.reason: After Ahithophel joined Absalom and died (2 Samuel 17:23), these men took his place as the king's advisers.

decisions.choice: Jehoiada son of Benaiah: perhaps a son of Benaiah named after his grandfather
decisions.reason: Elsewhere Benaiah is the son of Jehoiada (verse 5). This Jehoiada may be Benaiah's son, named after his grandfather, or the two names may have been reversed in copying.

decisions.choice: Abiathar; Joab: the priest and the commander of David's army
decisions.reason: Abiathar was the priest who escaped Saul's slaughter at Nob and stayed with David (1 Samuel 22:20-23; 2 Samuel 15:24-29). Joab son of Zeruiah was commander of the army (18:15).

decisions.choice: became the king's advisers
decisions.reason: Readable says what "after Ahithophel" means (m1).

decisions.choice: the commander of the king's army
decisions.reason: The wording for this title in Samuel, Kings and Chronicles; the Hebrew here adds "of the king".

decisions.choice: "군대 사령관"
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's word for the commander of the army.
